classifications: Mathematics of computing → Graphs and surfaces
statement: In this paper, we have studied the question which graphs can be realized as adjacency graphs of (convex-)polyhedral surfaces. In Corollary 16, we bound the maximum number emax (n) of edges in realizable graphs on n vertices by Ω(n log n) and O(n9/5 ). It would be interesting to improve upon these bounds. We conjecture that realizability is NP-hard to decide.
